REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condommium II, EDSA cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OF FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT 14 July 2008 53 S. 20n.e VICE MAYOR LUCITO D. ORAYA Dolores, Eastern Samar Dear Vice Mayor Oraya: This has reference to your letter raising the following issues/queries, to wit: 1. 2. 3. 4. "Can the Liga Municipal President who is now the Provincial Liga President continue to hold Office in the Sanggunian Bayan Hall, maintain control and supervision over employees detailed to the Office of the Liga Municipal President and continue to preside over Liga ng mga Barangay Municipal Chapter meetings? Since our Liga Municipal President could not be ex-officio member of two sanggunians, what would be his status in the Liga Municipal Chapter and Sangguniang Bayan of this Municipality if the Vice President will finally assume as ex- officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan? If the Liga Municipal Chapter Vice-President will automatically become an Ex-Officio member of the SB concerned once the Liga Municipal Chapter President is elected president of Liga Provincial Chapter as provided for in its Constitution and By-Laws, why the latter is technically not considered resigned when his position at the Municipal level is permanently occupied by his Vice President? Why is the Liga Municipal Vice President entitled to all benefits as Ex-Officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan when the Liga Municipal President retains his position in the

-2- municipal level as such while concurrently serving as Provincial Liga President even though he is no longer suppose to attend SB sessions?" Per your representation, the Liga ng mga Barangay Municipal President was elected as the Liga ng mga Barangay Provincial President of Eastern Samar and as such, shall sit as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan. The Liga ng mga Barangay Municipal Vice President, invoking the Constitution and By Laws of the Liga ng mga Barangay, wanted to assume as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan but the Sangguniang Bayan of Dolores did not allow his assumption based on the following reasons, viz: The assumption of the Municipal Liga Chapter Vice President in the SB Of Dolores is not supported by the Local Government Code (RA 7160); The Constitution and By-Laws (CBL) of the Liga cannot be made the basis of the aforesaid assumption since the same covers only the internal organization of the Liga and it affects — the the composition of other independent organization Sangguniang Bayan; The Liga CBL has no effect ofa law; and The said CBL is not suppletory to any provision of RA 7160. At the outset, allow us to quote the pertinent provisions of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160), thus: "SEC. 491. Purpose of Organization.- There shall be an organization of all barangays to be known as the Liga ng mga Barangay for the prinzary purpose of determining the representation of the Liga in the sanggunians, and for ventilating, articulating and crystallizing issues affecting barangay government administration and securing, through proper and legal means, solution thereto." "SEC. 492. Representation, Chapter, National Liga.— Every barangay shall be represented in said liga by the Punong barangay, xxx.

-3- "SEC. 494. Ex-Officio Membership in Sanggunians.- The duly elected presidents of the liga at the municipal, city and including the component cities and provincial levels, municipalities of Metropolitan Manila, shall serve as ex-officio members of the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panglungsod, sangguniang panlalawigan, respectively. xxx." "SEC. 507. Constitution and By-Laws of the Liga and the Leagues.- All other matters not herein otherwise provided for affecting the internal organizations of the leagues of local government units shall be governed by their respective constitution and by-laws which are hereby made suppletory the provision gf this Chapter: xxx." (underlining ours) Corollary to the foregoing, Section 5 (b), Article III of the• Constitution and By Laws of the Liga provides that: "No Liga chapter Presidents shall simultaneously be Ex-Officio member of two (2) sanggunians. When a Component City or Municipal Liga Chapter President is elected as Provincial Liga President and assumes the position of Ex-Officio member of the Sangguniang Panlalazvigan, the Vice-President of the Component City or Municipal Liga chapter shall automatically be the Ex-Officio member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod or Sangguniang Bayan, as the case may be, representing the Liga in the concemed Sanggunian. However, the provincial Chapter President shall retain his Presidency in the same Component City or Municipal Liga chapter, as the case may be." As to your queries, we will answer them jointly since they are interrelated and only pertain to one (I) subject matter. Based on the aforequoted provisions and this Department's previous opiliions, we are consistent in saying that the Municipal Liga Vice Presidents shall assume the ex-officio office in their local sanggunians the moment their Municipal Liga Presidents are elected President in the Provincial Liga and assumes their ex-officio posts in the Sanggunian Pantalawigan. The demands of their enormous functions would justify the delegation of their ex-officio seats in the Sangguniang Bayan to their Municipal Liga Vice Presidents. Please be reminded, however, that despite their election as the Provincial Liga Presidents and assumption as ex- officio members in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, they remain to be the Municipal Liga Presidents (maintains control and supervision over employees detailed to the Office of the Liga Municipal President and continue to preside over Liga Municipal Chapter meetings) notwithstanding

-4- the assumption of the Municipal Liga Chapter Vice President as ex-officio member in the Sangguniang Bayan of Dolores. We reiterate that this is so because being President of the Municipal Liga is the basic requirement for one's continued status and membership in the Sanggunian Panlalawigan A — President

1990 (Subject: Guidelines on the Payment of Compensation to Ex-Officio Members of the Local Sanggunian) issued by the Department of Budget and Management, thus: "3.0 Rules and Regulations 3.1 3.3 Ex-officio members of local legislative bodies as specified in R.A. No. 7160, shall receive the same compensation benefits as that of their counterpart elective Sanggunian officials. xxx The respective FederatioWChapter Vice-Presidents of the Liga ng mga Barangay xxx who sit in the Sangguniang Bayan as ex-officio members in lieu Of the Federation/Chapter President who are elevated to the higher Sanggunian, shall collect their full salaries and emoluments from the concerned municipal governments which they represent. xxx." Finally, we strongly advise you to allow the assumption of the Liga Municipal Chapter Vice President of your Municipality in your Sangguniang Bayan as ex-officio member thereof, to uphold the law and to avert possible legal complications in the future. We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary V cc: Hon. Arturo T. Cortez, Sr. Liga Municipal Chapter Vice President Dolores, E. Samar Director William C. Paler DILG Regional Office No. VIII Tacloban City
